name: nginx-multisite
description: Provisions Nginx as a secure multi-site static web server for three HTTPS-enabled virtual hosts, including TLS certificates, security headers, Fail2ban, UFW, SSH hardening, and sysctl settings.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis with password authentication on port 6379, and manages its log directory and configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI application from GitHub, initializes its database and environment, and runs it as a systemd service.
